Help-center excerpts:

[atm-limits] ATM withdrawal limits (effective 2025-01-01)
How much cash you can take out each day depends on your plan. The limit covers all ATMs combined, in the US and abroad.

| Plan | Daily ATM limit |
|---|---|
| Basic | $500 |
| Plus | $1,000 |
| Premium | $1,500 |

The daily limit resets at midnight Eastern Time.

## Can I raise my limit?

No. Limits are set by plan, and support can't raise them for a day or make exceptions. The only way to get a higher limit is to change plan.

## ATM limits versus the ATM's own

[atm-fees-basic-v1] ATM fees on Basic (effective 2025-01-01)
The ATM shows it on screen before you confirm.

## Daily limit

You can withdraw up to $500 a day on Basic.

## Where fees show up

Any Tallowbrook ATM fee appears as its own line in your activity feed, right after the withdrawal, so you can always see what you paid us and what the ATM owner charged. The app's ATM map shows the nearest BrookLink ATMs.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

a higher limit is to change plan.

## ATM limits versus the ATM's own limit

Many ATMs have their own maximum per withdrawal that's lower than ours. If you need more, you can make more than one withdrawal, as long as the total stays within your daily limit. Each withdrawal outside BrookLink may carry a fee.

Cash withdrawals are never covered by Cushion.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[atm-network] Finding a BrookLink ATM (effective 2025-01-01)
on your plan, and the ATM owner may add a surcharge. The ATM screen should show the owner's surcharge before you confirm.

## Daily limits

ATM withdrawals count toward a daily ATM limit that depends on your plan. See "ATM withdrawal limits".

## Depositing cash

BrookLink ATMs don't take cash deposits. To add cash, use a participating retail store instead. See "Depositing cash at a store".

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[transfer-limits-basic] Transfer limits on Basic (effective 2025-01-01)
reset at midnight Eastern Time. The monthly limit resets on the first day of each calendar month.

## Incoming transfers

There's no limit on money coming in by ACH, wire, direct deposit or BrookPay.

## New devices

For 24 hours after you sign in on a new device, BrookPay and external transfers are capped at $500.

## Need more?

Limits are set by plan. Support can't raise them, even for one transfer. Changing plan is the only way to get higher limits.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

[fees-all-v2] Fees for all plans (effective 2026-03-01)
free ($0.00) on every plan.
- ATM owners can add their own surcharge. That is separate from our fee.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

Can support raise my ATM limit just for today? I'm on Basic and need 800 bucks

Rules:
- Use only facts stated in the excerpts. Do not add fees, limits, dates, steps or products they do not mention.
- Some excerpts are older versions of a policy. When two excerpts disagree, follow the one with the later effective date.
- If the question depends on the customer's plan (Basic, Plus or Premium), use that plan's numbers.
- If the question rests on something false (for example a fee that does not exist), say so and give the correct facts. That is an answer, not an abstention.
- Abstain when the excerpts do not contain the answer, when the question is not about Tallowbrook, or when it asks for investment, tax or legal advice. Set "abstain" to true and say briefly that the help center does not cover it.
- Cite the article IDs (the text in square brackets) of every excerpt you used. Cite nothing when you abstain.
